blocks.prompt: 9 Find the value of \(x\) and \(y\) if \((-7 + i)(x + iy) + (-1 - 5i) = i(11 - i)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh ek equation hai jis mein unknown complex number \(x + iy\) ek complex number \((-7 + i)\) se multiply ho kar aaya hai, aur saath ek constant bhi jura hai.
Diya kya hai? \((-7 + i)(x + iy) + (-1 - 5i) = i(11 - i)\).
Find kya karna hai? Real numbers \(x\) aur \(y\).
Rule kaunsa? Jaise aam algebra mein \(3x + 5 = 11\) mein pehle 5 ko doosri taraf le jate hain, waise hi yahan constant ko right side le jayenge; phir expand kar ke equality of complex numbers.
Plan: right side simplify, constant ko right side, left side expand, parts compare, aur do linear equations solve.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((-7 + i)(x + iy) + (-1 - 5i) = i(11 - i)\), \(x, y\) real hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) aur \(y\).
Tareeqa: Dono sides ko (real) + (imaginary)\(i\) shakal mein layenge. Phir equality of complex numbers se do simultaneous linear equations milengi, jinhein substitution se solve karenge. (Doosra raasta: \(2 + 16i\) ko \(-7 + i\) se divide karna; dono se ek hi jawab aata hai.)

Right side simplify karein
\[i(11 - i) = 11i - i^2\]
\[= 1 + 11i\]
Kyun: \(i\) ko bracket ke dono terms se multiply kiya: \(11i\) aur \(-i^2\). Kyunke \(i^2 = -1\), \(-i^2 = +1\). Real part pehle likha: \(1 + 11i\).

Constant ko right side le jayein
\[(-7 + i)(x + iy) = 1 + 11i + 1 + 5i\]
\[= 2 + 16i\]
Kyun: Left side par \((-1 - 5i)\) jama ho raha hai; isay hatane ke liye dono sides se \((-1 - 5i)\) minus kiya. Minus karna \(1 + 5i\) jama karne ke barabar hai. Phir real \(1 + 1 = 2\) aur imaginary \(11i + 5i = 16i\).
Dhyan dein: Doosri taraf le jate waqt dono parts ka sign badalta hai; aksar students sirf \(-1\) ka sign badalte hain aur \(-5i\) bhool jate hain.

Left side expand karein
\[(-7 + i)(x + iy)\]
\[= -7x - 7iy + ix + i^2 y\]
\[= (-7x - y) + (x - 7y)i\]
Kyun: Term by term multiply kiya: \(-7 \cdot x\), \(-7 \cdot iy\), \(i \cdot x\), \(i \cdot iy = i^2 y = -y\). \(-y\) mein ab \(i\) nahi raha, is liye woh real part mein \(-7x\) ke saath gaya. \(i\) wale terms \(ix - 7iy\) se \(i\) common: \((x - 7y)i\).

Parts compare karein
\[-7x - y = 2 \quad (1)\]
\[x - 7y = 16 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Ab left side \((-7x - y) + (x - 7y)i\) aur right side \(2 + 16i\) hai. Equality of complex numbers: real se real (1), imaginary se imaginary (2). Do unknowns, do equations, ab aam algebra hai.

Equations solve karein
\[\text{From (1): } y = -7x - 2\]
\[x - 7(-7x - 2) = 16\]
\[50x + 14 = 16\]
\[x = \dfrac{2}{50} = \dfrac{1}{25}\]
\[y = -\dfrac{7}{25} - 2 = -\dfrac{57}{25}\]
Kyun: (1) se \(y\) akela karna aasaan tha: \(y = -7x - 2\). Isay (2) mein rakha: \(x + 49x + 14 = 16\), yani \(50x = 2\), \(x = \frac{1}{25}\). Phir \(y = -\frac{7}{25} - \frac{50}{25} = -\frac{57}{25}\).
Dhyan dein: \(-7(-7x - 2)\) kholte waqt dono terms plus bante hain: \(+49x + 14\).

Tasdeeq
\[(-7 + i)(1 - 57i)\]
\[= -7 + 399i + i - 57i^2\]
\[= 50 + 400i\]
\[\div 25: \; 2 + 16i \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x + iy = \frac{1 - 57i}{25}\) hai. Fractions se bachne ke liye pehle \(1 - 57i\) ko \(-7 + i\) se multiply kiya: \(-57i^2 = +57\), real \(-7 + 57 = 50\), imaginary \(399i + i = 400i\). Phir 25 se divide kiya to \(2 + 16i\) mila, jo step 3 ka right side hai. Jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x = \frac{1}{25},\ y = -\frac{57}{25}\)
Yani \(x + iy = \frac{1 - 57i}{25}\); jawab fractions mein hai, aur yeh bilkul theek hai.
